title: Requirements to dependencies
summary: For each requirement, a sub-agent finds the platform capabilities that could meet it. The product manager starts, answers and reviews twenty explorations on one board.

inputs.name: platform map
inputs.hint: What the platform offers. Looks in context/ first.

launchers.label: Map dependencies
launchers.prompt: Map the platform dependencies for the requirements in {path}.

when: The person has a requirements catalog and wants to know which platform capabilities each requirement depends on
not_when: Project dependencies between teams or dates (that is delivery status)
routing.needs: A requirements dataset from PRD to requirements, and a platform map in context/
routing.offer: Your requirements are catalogued. The next step maps what the platform offers for each one, on a board you start and review tile by tile.

start: Map the platform dependencies for data/held-payments.json.
offer: The requirements are locked. What do we need from the platform teams?
open: Which platform team is usually slowest to respond?

invariants: Never invent a capability the platform map does not describe
Never mark an exploration reviewed; that is the person's
